components.name: ComboRow
components.description: A settings row choosing one of a list, the choice at its end: a grouped form's Picker on macOS (the choice before a circle with up and down chevrons), a SettingsCard holding a ComboBox on Windows 11, or AdwComboRow on GNOME, where the whole row opens the list. It joins a Card, a Fieldset or an AccordionItem as ActionRow does.

components.name: EntryRow
components.description: A settings row editing a text, named by its title: a grouped form's TextField with a label on macOS (the text at the trailing edge, no bezel), a SettingsCard holding a TextBox on Windows 11, or AdwEntryRow on GNOME, its title shrinking above the text as the row is focused or filled. It joins a Card, a Fieldset or an AccordionItem as ActionRow does.

components.name: ExpanderRow
components.description: A settings row that opens to show the rows built in it: a grouped form's DisclosureGroup on macOS, CommunityToolkit's SettingsExpander on Windows 11, or AdwExpanderRow on GNOME, each with the platform's own header and arrow. Alone it is a group of its own; in a Card, a Fieldset or an AccordionItem it joins as a row does.

components.name: SpinRow
components.description: A settings row setting a number between limits with stepping buttons, its text the one focus stop: a grouped form's Stepper with its value in a text field on macOS, a SettingsCard holding a NumberBox on Windows 11, or AdwSpinRow on GNOME, with circular − and + buttons. It joins a Card, a Fieldset or an AccordionItem as ActionRow does.
